-Versus-
State of West Bengal & Ors.
Mr. Bhagabat Chowdhury, Sk. Taslim Ali, Ms. Saba Parween ....for
The petitioner complains of inadequate investigation into the Amta P.S. Case No. 388/22 dated 16.12.2022 under Sections 498A/304B/34 of the IPC.
This Court is not satisfied with the report of the Officer-in-Charge, Amta Police Station, Howrah Rural District.

entities.text: Amta Police Station, Howrah Rural District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The case diary shall be produced on the adjourned date.
It shall be indicated as to the number of witnesses who have been examined under Section 161 of the Cr. P.C. and whether any statements under Section 164 of the Cr. P.C. have been recorded.
The medical report of the Hospital must be procured.
The post mortem report shall also be produced.
It shall also be indicated as to why the accused have not been arrested till date.
The report filed today by the Amta Police is kept with the record.

(Rajasekhar Mantha, J.)
